verdict.summary: Cream cheese is generally gluten-free, but cross-contamination during preparation or with added flavorings can pose a risk for those with coeliac disease. It's essential to ensure that no gluten-containing ingredients are mixed in or that the equipment used is not contaminated.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Cream-cheese can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
